'''Nashia''' is a [[Kin]]swoman.

== Appearance ==
She is prim with a youthful face.

== Activities ==
Nashia, with the assistance of three other Kinswomen, creates a [[gateway]] into [[Cairhien]] for [[Elayne Trakand]].
